name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end procedure for opening customer accounts at FirstUK Bank, governed by retail banking operations and compliance requirements. Effective from 2026-01-15, version 2.1, owned by Head of Retail Banking. This SOP was superseded by version 3 effective 2026-03-01.

name: Branch Staff
description: Frontline personnel responsible for executing account opening procedures and customer interactions at branch level. Listed as primary audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Customer Service, Operations, Compliance

name: Customer Service
description: Customer-facing operational role responsible for supporting account opening processes and customer inquiries. Identified as audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Customer Service, Operations, Compliance

name: Operations Staff
description: Back-office operational personnel responsible for processing and recording account opening activities. Listed as audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Customer Service, Operations, Compliance

name: Compliance Staff
description: Compliance personnel responsible for ensuring adherence to regulatory and policy requirements throughout the account opening process. Identified as audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Branch Staff, Customer Service, Operations, Compliance

name: Head of Retail Banking
description: Senior management role responsible for ownership and governance of the Account Opening SOP. Accountable for process oversight and updates.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end standardized procedure for opening customer accounts across SmartSaver, Current, and Mortgage products through branch, online, and postal channels. The process ensures regulatory compliance, data accuracy, and consistent customer experience throughout account establishment.
context: Establish standardized procedures for opening customer accounts (SmartSaver, Current, Mortgage) across all channels (branch, online, postal)
to ensure regulatory compliance, data accuracy, and consistent customer experience

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A savings account product offered as part of the standardized account opening process across multiple channels.

name: Current Account
description: A current account product offered as part of the standardized account opening process across multiple channels.

name: Mortgage
description: A mortgage product offered as part of the standardized account opening process across multiple channels.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end procedure for opening new customer accounts across all product types and delivery channels. Applies to savings, current, and mortgage products offered through branch, online, and postal channels at all bank locations.

name: Savings Account
description: Savings account product offered as part of the account opening process across all channels and locations.

name: Current Account
description: Current account product offered as part of the account opening process across all channels and locations.

name: Mortgage
description: Mortgage product offered as part of the account opening process across all channels and locations.

name: New Customer
description: Individual applying to open a new account under the account opening process. Subject to all verification and compliance requirements across all product types and channels.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end procedure for opening a new customer account, encompassing channel selection, application completion, KYC verification, AML screening, risk assessment, approval decision, account creation, card issuance, and customer notification. Timeline varies by channel: 1–2 business days for online/branch channels, 5–7 days for postal applications.

name: Customer Request Submission
description: Initial step where a customer initiates the account opening process by submitting a request.

name: Channel Selection
description: Customer selects the channel through which to proceed with account opening: Branch, Online, or Postal.

name: Application Form Completion
description: Customer completes the account opening application form with required personal and financial information.

name: KYC Verification
description: Verification of customer identity and address documentation as part of Know Your Customer compliance obligations.

name: AML Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening performed to assess customer against sanctions and PEP lists.

name: Risk Assessment
description: Comprehensive risk assessment of the customer and application to determine suitability and compliance profile.

name: Approval or Rejection Decision
description: Final decision point where the application is either approved or rejected based on KYC, AML, and risk assessment outcomes.

name: Account Creation
description: System creation of the new account in the banking system, executed only if the application is approved.

name: Card Issuance
description: Issuance of a payment card associated with the new account, where applicable based on product type and customer eligibility.

name: Customer Notification
description: Communication to the customer regarding the outcome of their account opening application and next steps.

name: Account Activation
description: Final step enabling the customer to use the newly opened account for transactions and services.

name: Application Approval Gate
description: Decision point determining whether the account opening application is approved or rejected based on KYC, AML, and risk assessment results. Approved applications proceed to account creation; rejected applications terminate the process.

name: Identity and Address Verification
description: Know Your Customer verification process requiring collection and validation of customer identity and address documentation during account opening.

name: Sanctions and PEP Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process checking customer against sanctions lists and Politically Exposed Person registers as part of account opening compliance.

name: Account Opening Applicant
description: Individual customer applying to open a new account through the account opening process.

name: New Account
description: Account created upon approval of the account opening application, subject to successful completion of all verification and compliance steps.

name: Payment Card
description: Payment card issued to the customer in connection with the newly opened account, where applicable based on product and eligibility.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end procedure for opening a new customer account at a branch. Begins with customer arrival and intent statement, proceeds through product selection and explanation, and involves branch staff interaction via paper or digital forms. Encompasses multiple product types including savings and transactional accounts.
context: Customer states intent: 'I want to open a savings account'
Branch staff pulls up account opening form (paper or tablet)
Explain products available (SmartSaver, Current Account, etc.)

name: Customer Request and Intent Statement
description: Initial step where customer arrives at branch and verbally states their intent to open an account. Branch staff greets the customer and offers seating to begin the account opening process.
context: Customer states intent: 'I want to open a savings account'
Branch staff greets customer, offers seating

name: Account Opening Form Retrieval
description: Branch staff retrieves and presents the account opening form to the customer, available in either paper or digital tablet format. This form serves as the primary documentation vehicle for capturing customer information.
context: Branch staff pulls up account opening form (paper or tablet)

name: Product Explanation and Availability
description: Branch staff explains the range of available banking products to the customer, including savings accounts, current accounts, and lending products. This step enables the customer to make an informed product selection decision.
context: Explain products available (SmartSaver, Current Account, etc.)

name: Product Selection by Customer
description: Customer selects their preferred banking product from the available options presented by branch staff. This decision determines which account type and associated terms will apply to the new account.

name: Branch Staff
description: Bank employee stationed at the branch responsible for greeting customers, retrieving account opening forms, explaining available products, and facilitating the initial stages of account opening. Acts as the primary point of contact during the branch-based account opening process.
context: Branch staff greets customer, offers seating
Branch staff pulls up account opening form (paper or tablet)
Explain products available (SmartSaver, Current Account, etc.)

name: Individual Customer
description: Natural person seeking to open a new bank account at a branch. Initiates the account opening process by stating their intent and participates in product selection and information provision steps.
context: Customer states intent: 'I want to open a savings account'

name: SmartSaver Account
description: Savings account product offered by the bank as part of the account opening process. Presented to customers as one of the available account types during product selection.
context: Explain products available (SmartSaver, Current Account, etc.)

name: Current Account
description: Transactional account product offered by the bank as part of the account opening process. Presented to customers as one of the available account types for day-to-day banking needs.
context: Explain products available (SmartSaver, Current Account, etc.)

name: Mortgage
description: Lending product offered by the bank as part of the account opening process. Presented to customers as one of the available product options during the branch interaction.
context: Explain products available (SmartSaver, Current Account, etc.)

name: Online Account Opening Process
description: An end-to-end digital account opening workflow initiated by a customer through the bank's website. The process includes product selection, online form completion, and KYC verification, with an estimated completion time of 15–20 minutes when required documents are available.

name: Navigate to Account Opening Page
description: The initial step where a customer accesses the bank's website and navigates to the dedicated account opening interface.

name: Select Product Type
description: The step where the customer chooses which banking product they wish to open, establishing the product context for the remainder of the process.

name: Complete Online Form
description: The step where the customer fills out the required online application form with their personal and account details.

name: Proceed Through KYC Verification
description: The compliance step where the customer completes Know Your Customer verification as part of the online account opening workflow.

name: KYC Verification
description: The Know Your Customer verification process executed during online account opening to establish and verify the customer's identity and address.

name: Individual Customer
description: A natural person initiating an account opening through the online channel by navigating the website and completing the application process.

name: Postal Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end procedure for customers to open an account via postal application. Customer requests a postal pack through phone support or website, receives application forms by mail with prepaid envelope, completes and returns the forms, and Operations staff processes the application. Estimated completion time is 5–7 days.
context: Phone support or website requests postal pack
Application forms mailed to customer (with prepaid envelope)
Customer completes and returns by mail

name: Postal Pack Request
description: Customer initiates the postal account opening process by requesting a postal pack through phone support or the website.
context: Phone support or website requests postal pack

name: Application Forms Mailing
description: Application forms are mailed to the customer along with a prepaid envelope for return submission.
context: Application forms mailed to customer (with prepaid envelope)

name: Customer Application Completion and Return
description: Customer completes the application forms and returns them by mail using the prepaid envelope provided.
context: Customer completes and returns by mail

name: Operations Processing
description: Operations staff receives and processes the returned application forms to complete the account opening.

name: Phone Support
description: Customer service role responsible for receiving postal pack requests from customers via phone.
context: Phone support or website requests postal pack

name: Website System
description: Automated system through which customers can request a postal pack online.
context: Phone support or website requests postal pack

name: Operations Team
description: Operations team responsible for processing completed postal application forms received from customers.

name: Postal Application Customer
description: Individual customer who requests and completes a postal application to open an account.
context: Customer completes and returns by mail

name: Application Form Completion
description: The step where applicants provide personal, financial, and product preference information required to open an account. This step captures identity details, address history, source of funds, transaction expectations, and product selection including card type and payment instruction preferences.
context: Personal Details: Full legal name, Date of birth, Nationality, Occupation/employment, Contact details (email, phone), Address (current + previous if <3 years)
Financial Information: Source of funds (for initial deposit), Expected transaction volume, Income range (if applicable)
Product Selection: Product type and features requested, Account access preferences, Card type (if applicable), Standing orders/direct debits (if known)

name: Full Legal Name
description: The applicant's full legal name as required personal detail during application form completion.

name: Date of Birth
description: The applicant's date of birth as a required personal detail during application form completion.

name: Nationality
description: The applicant's nationality as a required personal detail during application form completion.

name: Current Address
description: The applicant's current residential address collected during application form completion as a required personal detail.

name: Previous Address
description: The applicant's previous residential address collected during application form completion if the current address has been held for less than 3 years.

name: Product Type
description: The banking product type and features requested by the applicant during application form completion, including account access preferences.
context: Product Selection: Product type and features requested, Account access preferences

name: Card Type
description: The card type (if applicable) selected by the applicant during application form completion as part of product selection.

name: Standing Order
description: Standing order payment instructions that may be known and specified by the applicant during application form completion.

name: Direct Debit
description: Direct debit mandates that may be known and specified by the applicant during application form completion.

name: Applicant
description: The individual applying for an account who provides personal, financial, and product preference information during application form completion.
context: Personal Details: Full legal name, Date of birth, Nationality, Occupation/employment, Contact details (email, phone), Address (current + previous if <3 years)
Financial Information: Source of funds (for initial deposit), Expected transaction volume, Income range (if applicable)

name: Data Accuracy Check Process
description: A multi-channel data validation procedure executed by Branch Staff, Online systems, and Operations staff to verify customer information accuracy, completeness, and correct formatting before account processing. The process includes spelling verification, contact detail confirmation, mandatory field validation, and handwriting clarification.

name: Customer Information Verification
description: Branch Staff verify customer-provided information for accuracy and completeness, including spelling checks and confirmation of contact details.

name: Real-Time Online Validation
description: Automated online system performs real-time validation of customer data including email format verification, postcode validation, and mandatory field checks.

name: Postal Submission Completeness Review
description: Operations staff review postal submissions for completeness, contact customers regarding missing information, and clarify unclear handwriting on submitted documents.

name: Branch Staff
description: Branch Staff responsible for verifying customer information accuracy, checking spelling, confirming contact details, and reviewing data completeness during in-branch data accuracy checks.

name: Online Validation System
description: Automated online system that performs real-time validation of customer data including email format checks, postcode verification, and mandatory field validation.

name: Operations Staff
description: Operations staff responsible for reviewing postal submissions for completeness, contacting customers regarding missing information, and verifying handwriting clarity on submitted documents.

name: Identity Verification
description: A Know Your Customer process step that verifies the identity of customers as part of account opening procedures. This step is governed by detailed KYC procedures documented in the customer identification policy.

name: Customer Identification Policy
description: A referenced policy document that contains detailed KYC procedures and customer identification requirements. This policy governs the identity verification step in account opening workflows.

name: UK Passport
description: UK Passport accepted as primary identification document for branch opening requiring original examination, and for online/postal opening when provided as scan, photo, or notarized certified copy.
context: Scan/photo of passport or driving license

name: UK Driving License
description: UK Driving License (photocard) accepted as primary identification document for branch opening requiring original examination, and for online/postal opening when provided as scan, photo, or notarized certified copy.
context: Scan/photo of passport or driving license
Notarized copy (certified by solicitor, notary, etc.)

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end account opening procedure with three distinct channels: branch opening (physical document required), online opening (certified copy required), and postal opening (certified copy required). Each channel specifies acceptable identification documents and certification requirements.

name: Branch Document Examination
description: Physical examination of original UK Passport or UK Driving License photocard during in-branch account opening. This step requires direct inspection of the original document.

name: Online Document Submission
description: Submission of certified copy identification documents for online account opening, including scan/photo of passport or driving license with notarized certification for postal copies.
context: Scan/photo of passport or driving license

name: Postal Document Submission
description: Submission of certified copy identification documents for postal account opening, including scan attached to application or notarized copy certified by solicitor or notary.
context: Notarized copy (certified by solicitor, notary, etc.)

name: Verification Process
description: A multi-channel identity document verification procedure executed across branch, online, and postal channels. The process involves document collection, physical examination, system recording, and validation checks, with processing times ranging from under 1 minute (online) to 1–2 business days (postal).

name: Document Collection
description: Initial step in which primary identity documents are requested from the customer. Document number, issue date, and expiry date are recorded, and validity is checked to ensure the document has not expired.

name: Physical Verification
description: Branch-only step in which the document is physically examined, the customer's photo is compared to their appearance, signature is verified, and any document concerns are noted.

name: System Recording
description: Document type and number are entered into the system, linked to the customer record in AMS (Account Management System), and marked as 'verified' to complete the verification workflow.

name: Primary Identity Document
description: An official identity document collected and verified during the verification process. The document's number, issue date, and expiry date are recorded, and its validity is checked to ensure it has not expired.

name: Branch Staff
description: Personnel responsible for executing physical verification steps at branch locations, including document examination, photo comparison, signature verification, and recording of document concerns.

name: Automated System
description: Automated system responsible for online document verification and system recording. Processes identity documents in under 1 minute and records verified documents in the Account Management System (AMS).

name: Address Verification
description: A discrete step within a customer identification workflow that verifies the customer's address according to established procedures. This step is part of a larger process and references detailed policy documentation for execution.
context: See [[policy_customer_identification]] for detailed address verification procedures.

name: Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate within the customer identification process that ensures address verification is completed according to regulatory and policy requirements before the workflow can proceed.
context: See [[policy_customer_identification]] for detailed address verification procedures.

name: Utility Bill
description: A utility bill document accepted as primary proof of address, valid when dated within 3 months of submission. This is the preferred document type for address verification in banking onboarding processes.

name: Council Tax Document
description: A council tax document accepted as primary proof of address for customer verification. This is a preferred document type in the acceptable documents list.

name: Bank Statement
description: A bank statement accepted as primary proof of address for customer verification purposes. This is a preferred document type in the acceptable documents list.

name: Mortgage Statement
description: A mortgage statement accepted as primary proof of address for customer verification. This is a preferred document type in the acceptable documents list.

name: Tenancy Agreement
description: A tenancy agreement accepted as secondary proof of address when primary documents are unavailable. This is an alternative document type for address verification.

name: Insurance Policy
description: An insurance policy document accepted as secondary proof of address when primary documents are unavailable. This is an alternative document type for address verification.

name: HM Revenue & Customs Letter
description: An HM Revenue & Customs letter accepted as secondary proof of address when primary documents are unavailable. This is an alternative document type for address verification.

name: Electoral Register Extract
description: An electoral register extract accepted as secondary proof of address when primary documents are unavailable. This is an alternative document type for address verification.

name: Verification Process
description: An end-to-end address verification workflow comprising document collection, address comparison, and system recording. The process validates that a customer's address matches acceptable proof-of-address documentation and confirms UK address format compliance before marking the address as verified in the system.
context: Compare address on ID with address document

name: Document Collection
description: The initial step in which address verification documentation is requested from the customer. The step includes recording the document type and date of the document provided.

name: Address Comparison and Validation
description: The verification step in which the address on the customer's ID is compared against the address document provided. The step confirms UK address format compliance (postcode validation) and validates that both addresses match.
context: Compare address on ID with address document

name: System Recording
description: The final step in which verified address information is recorded in the banking system. The step includes entering the address document type, linking the document to the customer record, and marking the address status as verified.

name: Address Verification
description: The address verification control point within the verification process. Requires collection of proof-of-address documentation, comparison with customer ID, and confirmation of UK address format before the address is marked as verified in the system.
context: Compare address on ID with address document

name: Address Verification Document
description: An official document collected during the verification process to prove the customer's address. The document type and date are recorded, and the address on the document is compared against the customer's ID to confirm matching and UK format compliance.
context: Compare address on ID with address document

name: AML Screening Process
description: The Anti-Money Laundering screening procedure executed as part of operational workflows. This process is detailed in the referenced AML policy document and represents a mandatory compliance gate within banking operations.

name: AML Screening Execution
description: The discrete step within a larger process where AML screening is performed. This step references external AML policy documentation for procedural details and compliance requirements.

name: AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint
description: The mandatory regulatory compliance gate where AML screening results are verified before process advancement. This checkpoint ensures adherence to anti-money laundering obligations as defined in the referenced AML policy.

name: OFAC Sanctions List Screening
aliases: Office of Foreign Assets Control screening
description: Mandatory screening requirement against the OFAC Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This is a first-line sanctions check applied to all customers and transactions.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: OFAC Sanctions List

name: EU Consolidated Sanctions List Screening
description: Mandatory screening requirement against the EU Consolidated Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This check applies to all customers and transactions subject to EU regulatory jurisdiction.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: EU Consolidated Sanctions List

name: HMT Sanctions List Screening
description: Mandatory screening requirement against the HMT Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This is a UK-specific sanctions check required for all customers and transactions.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: HMT Sanctions List

name: UN Sanctions List Screening
description: Mandatory screening requirement against the UN Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This check applies to all customers and transactions to ensure compliance with international sanctions regimes.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: UN Sanctions List

name: PEP Database Screening
description: Mandatory screening requirement against the PEP Database to identify politically exposed persons as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This check applies to all customers to mitigate reputational and financial crime risks.

name: Adverse Media Screening
description: Additional screening requirement applied to high-risk customers to identify negative news, reputational concerns, or adverse information about the customer or their beneficial owners. This enhanced check supplements mandatory sanctions and PEP screening.

name: Beneficial Ownership Screening
description: Additional screening requirement applied to high-risk entity customers to identify and verify beneficial owners. This enhanced due diligence check is conditional on the customer being classified as an entity rather than an individual.

name: Screening Process
description: An end-to-end AML screening workflow that performs automated name-based checks against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists, with manual review and escalation gates for matches. The process includes match assessment, hit handling with risk-based branching, and system recording of results.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
Processing Time: 5–10 minutes (automated with manual review if needed)

name: Name Screening
description: Automated system check of customer name against all screening lists. Results are generated within 1 minute.
context: Customer name screened against all lists

name: Match Assessment
description: Manual review by Compliance staff to assess whether a name match is a true positive or false positive based on name similarity. If no match is found, the process proceeds to the next step.
context: If no match: Proceed to next step
If match found: Manual review by Compliance
False positive assessment (name similarity vs. true match)

name: Hit Handling
description: Risk-based handling of screening matches with three distinct paths: sanctions matches trigger immediate escalation and account blocking; PEP matches require enhanced due diligence; adverse media matches trigger risk assessment and possible rejection.
context: If sanctions match: Escalate immediately, account blocked, Compliance notified
If PEP match: Enhanced due diligence required
If adverse media: Risk assessment, possible rejection

name: Record
description: Documentation of screening results in the system, including any matches found and their resolution, with linkage to the customer account record.

name: Compliance Officer
description: Manual reviewer responsible for assessing name matches for false positives and handling escalations. Notified of sanctions matches and responsible for enhanced due diligence decisions on PEP matches.
context: If match found: Manual review by Compliance
If sanctions match: Escalate immediately, account blocked, Compliance notified
If PEP match: Enhanced due diligence required

name: Screening System
description: Automated system that performs name-based screening checks against all lists and records screening results in the system with linkage to account records.

name: Name Match Found
description: Branch point determining whether the name screening returned a match. No match leads to process continuation; a match triggers manual review by Compliance.
context: If no match: Proceed to next step
If match found: Manual review by Compliance

name: Match Type Classification
description: Risk-based branching that classifies the type of match found and routes to appropriate handling: sanctions matches escalate immediately with account blocking, PEP matches require enhanced due diligence, and adverse media matches trigger risk assessment.
context: If sanctions match: Escalate immediately, account blocked, Compliance notified
If PEP match: Enhanced due diligence required
If adverse media: Risk assessment, possible rejection

name: Sanctions Screening Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance gate that verifies screening against sanctions lists. A positive match triggers immediate escalation, account blocking, and Compliance notification.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
If sanctions match: Escalate immediately, account blocked, Compliance notified

name: PEP Screening Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance gate that verifies screening against PEP (Politically Exposed Person) lists. A positive match requires enhanced due diligence before proceeding.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
If PEP match: Enhanced due diligence required

name: Adverse Media Screening Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance gate that verifies screening against adverse media sources. A positive match triggers risk assessment and may result in account rejection.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
If adverse media: Risk assessment, possible rejection

name: Sanctions Screening
description: Automated screening of customer name against sanctions lists as part of the overall screening process. Positive matches result in immediate escalation and account blocking.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
If sanctions match: Escalate immediately, account blocked, Compliance notified

name: PEP Screening
description: Automated screening of customer name against PEP (Politically Exposed Person) lists. Positive matches require enhanced due diligence assessment.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
If PEP match: Enhanced due diligence required

name: Adverse Media Screening
description: Automated screening of customer name against adverse media sources. Positive matches trigger risk assessment and possible account rejection.
context: Customer name screened against all lists
If adverse media: Risk assessment, possible rejection

name: Enhanced Due Diligence
description: Enhanced verification procedure required when a customer matches a PEP screening result. This additional due diligence is mandatory before the account can proceed.
context: If PEP match: Enhanced due diligence required

name: Customer
description: The individual subject of the screening process whose name is checked against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists.
context: Customer name screened against all lists

name: Risk Assessment Process
description: A systematic process for determining customer risk level based on multiple factors including age, nationality, PEP status, adverse media presence, and product/account characteristics. The process categorizes customers into Low, Medium, or High Risk tiers to inform compliance and onboarding decisions.

name: Customer Risk Level Determination
description: The step in which customer risk is evaluated and scored based on five key factors: age, nationality/residence, PEP status, adverse media findings, and product/account size. This determination feeds into the risk categorization decision.

name: Risk Category Classification Gate
description: A branching decision point that assigns customers to one of three risk categories (Low, Medium, or High) based on the aggregated risk scoring factors. Each category triggers different compliance and operational pathways.
context: Low Risk: Standard customer, standard product, standard amount
Medium Risk: Higher-value account or foreign residence
High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

name: PEP Status Screening Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate that verifies whether a customer or their family members hold Politically Exposed Person status. PEP status is a key risk factor that elevates the customer to Medium or High Risk category.
context: High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

name: Adverse Media Screening Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate that checks for adverse media findings associated with the customer. Presence of adverse media elevates risk classification to Medium or High Risk.
context: High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

name: Individual Customer
description: A natural person subject to risk assessment during the onboarding or account management process. Customer risk profile is determined by demographic, geographic, regulatory, and product-related factors.
context: Standard customer, standard product, standard amount

name: Standard Account
description: A standard-tier account product that carries lower risk classification when held by a standard customer with standard transaction amounts.
context: Low Risk: Standard customer, standard product, standard amount

name: High-Value Account
description: A higher-tier account product with elevated transaction amounts or balances that increases risk classification, particularly when combined with foreign residence or other risk factors.
context: Medium Risk: Higher-value account or foreign residence
High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

name: Enhanced Due Diligence Process
description: A mandatory compliance procedure triggered for high-risk customers requiring senior staff review, beneficial ownership verification, source of funds documentation, and additional screening before account approval. The process culminates in formal approval by the Compliance Head.
context: EDD Escalation: Refer to Compliance Head for approval

name: Senior Staff Review
description: Initial review step performed by senior staff to assess the high-risk customer profile and determine the scope of enhanced due diligence required.

name: Beneficial Ownership Verification
description: Verification step required for entity customers to identify and confirm the beneficial owners behind the legal entity structure.

name: Source of Funds Documentation
description: Collection and review of documentation evidencing the legitimate source of funds for the high-risk customer's account activity.

name: Additional Screening
description: Enhanced screening procedures beyond standard AML and sanctions checks, applied to high-risk customers as part of the EDD process.

name: Compliance Head Approval
description: Final approval gate requiring formal sign-off from the Compliance Head before the enhanced due diligence process is concluded and the customer account can proceed.

name: Senior Staff
description: Operations personnel responsible for conducting the initial senior staff review of high-risk customers during the Enhanced Due Diligence process.

name: Compliance Head
description: Senior compliance authority responsible for final approval of Enhanced Due Diligence cases and escalated high-risk customer assessments.
context: EDD Escalation: Refer to Compliance Head for approval

name: Compliance Head Escalation Level
description: Escalation tier for Enhanced Due Diligence cases requiring senior compliance authority review and approval decision on high-risk customer onboarding.
context: EDD Escalation: Refer to Compliance Head for approval

name: High-Risk Customer Enhanced Due Diligence Checkpoint
description: Mandatory regulatory compliance gate that verifies completion of enhanced due diligence obligations for high-risk customers before account approval can proceed.

name: Enhanced Due Diligence Verification
description: Comprehensive KYC verification procedure for high-risk customers incorporating beneficial ownership verification, source of funds documentation, and additional screening beyond standard identity and address verification.

name: Account Opening Approval Process
description: The final approval or rejection gate for account opening, where compliance criteria are verified and an approval authority grants or denies account activation. The process includes risk-based routing to different approval authorities and defines approval timelines by channel.
context: Account Approved If: KYC verification complete and successful, Address verification complete, AML screening passed (no sanctions hits), Risk assessment acceptable, No regulatory concerns, Account opening form complete and accurate
Approval Authority: Low-Medium Risk: Account Manager approval, High Risk: Compliance Head approval, Exceptions: CRO approval (if policy exception)

name: KYC Verification Completion Check
description: Verification that KYC verification has been completed and was successful, as a mandatory approval criterion before account activation.

name: Address Verification Completion Check
description: Verification that address verification has been completed as a mandatory approval criterion before account activation.

name: AML Screening Results Review
description: Review of AML screening results to confirm no sanctions hits have been detected, as a mandatory approval criterion before account activation.

name: Risk Assessment Evaluation
description: Evaluation of the customer's risk profile to determine whether the risk level is acceptable for account approval.

name: Regulatory Concerns Check
description: Verification that no regulatory concerns exist that would prevent account approval.

name: Account Opening Form Accuracy Verification
description: Verification that the account opening form is complete and accurate as a mandatory approval criterion.
context: Account opening form complete and accurate

name: Approval Decision Recording
description: The formal approval or rejection decision made by the appropriate authority based on all approval criteria.
context: Approval Authority: Low-Medium Risk: Account Manager approval, High Risk: Compliance Head approval, Exceptions: CRO approval (if policy exception)

name: Account Manager
description: The approval authority responsible for approving account openings classified as low to medium risk.

name: Compliance Head
description: The approval authority responsible for approving account openings classified as high risk.

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: The approval authority responsible for approving account openings that require policy exceptions.

name: Risk Level Classification Gate
description: A branching decision that routes the approval to different authorities based on the customer's risk classification: low-medium risk to Account Manager, high risk to Compliance Head, or exceptions to CRO.
context: Approval Authority: Low-Medium Risk: Account Manager approval, High Risk: Compliance Head approval, Exceptions: CRO approval (if policy exception)

name: Approval Criteria Gate
description: A compliance gate that determines whether all mandatory approval criteria have been satisfied (KYC complete, address verified, AML passed, risk acceptable, no regulatory concerns, form complete) before account activation can proceed.
context: Account Approved If: KYC verification complete and successful, Address verification complete, AML screening passed (no sanctions hits), Risk assessment acceptable, No regulatory concerns, Account opening form complete and accurate

name: KYC Verification Completion Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that KYC verification has been completed and successful before account approval can be granted.

name: Address Verification Completion Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that address verification has been completed before account approval can be granted.

name: AML Screening Clearance Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that AML screening has been passed with no sanctions hits before account approval can be granted.

name: Risk Assessment Acceptance Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that the customer's risk assessment is acceptable before account approval can be granted.

name: Regulatory Concerns Clearance Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that no regulatory concerns exist before account approval can be granted.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end account opening workflow that includes KYC verification, AML screening, PEP/adverse media checks, beneficial ownership verification, and source of funds assessment. Accounts are rejected if any compliance checkpoint fails, with rejection notification issued to the customer without disclosure of AML-related reasons to prevent tipping off.
context: Account Rejected If: KYC verification failed (cannot verify identity)

name: KYC Verification Check
description: Mandatory step to verify customer identity during account opening. Rejection occurs if identity cannot be verified, preventing account opening.

name: AML Screening Check
description: Sanctions and AML list screening step performed during account opening. Account is rejected if a confirmed sanctions match is identified.

name: PEP and Adverse Media Assessment
description: Assessment of Politically Exposed Person status and adverse media findings during account opening. Account is rejected if PEP or adverse media risk cannot be mitigated.

name: Beneficial Ownership Verification
description: Verification step to establish clear beneficial ownership, particularly for entity customers. Account is rejected if beneficial ownership cannot be clearly determined.

name: Source of Funds Assessment
description: Assessment of the customer's source of funds during account opening. Account is rejected if source of funds is deemed suspicious or presents a fraud concern.

name: Regulatory Exception Review
description: Review of any regulatory exceptions or exemptions that may apply to the account opening. Account is rejected if the regulatory exception is denied.

name: Rejection Notification
description: Written notification sent to customer when account opening is rejected. The notification does not disclose AML-related reasons to prevent tipping off, using a standard generic message.
context: Written notice to customer (no AML reason disclosed—tipping off risk)
Letter: "We are unable to open your account at this time. Please contact us for more information."

name: Account Approval Decision
description: Branching decision point determining whether account opening proceeds or is rejected based on compliance checkpoint outcomes. Multiple rejection criteria exist: KYC failure, AML hit, PEP/adverse media risk, unclear beneficial ownership, suspicious source of funds, or denied regulatory exception.
context: Account Rejected If: KYC verification failed (cannot verify identity)

name: KYC Verification Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint verifying customer identity before account opening can proceed. Failure to verify identity results in account rejection.

name: AML Screening Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint performing AML and sanctions screening. Confirmed sanctions matches trigger account rejection.

name: PEP and Adverse Media Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint assessing PEP status and adverse media. Unmitigable PEP or adverse media risk results in account rejection.

name: Beneficial Ownership Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint establishing clear beneficial ownership, particularly for entity customers. Unclear beneficial ownership results in account rejection.

name: Account Applicant
description: Natural person or entity applying for account opening. Subject to KYC verification, AML screening, PEP assessment, beneficial ownership verification, and source of funds assessment. Receives rejection notification if account opening is denied.
context: Written notice to customer (no AML reason disclosed—tipping off risk)
Please contact us for more information

name: Sanctions Screening
description: AML screening process checking customer against sanctions lists. Confirmed sanctions matches result in account rejection.

name: PEP Screening
description: Screening to identify Politically Exposed Person status. PEP designation that cannot be mitigated results in account rejection.

name: Adverse Media Check
description: Screening for adverse media findings on customer. Adverse media risk that cannot be mitigated results in account rejection.

name: Identity Verification
description: KYC process to verify customer identity during account opening. Failure to verify identity is a rejection criterion.

name: New Account
description: Account being opened subject to compliance verification and rejection criteria. Account opening is rejected if KYC, AML, PEP, beneficial ownership, source of funds, or regulatory exception checks fail.
context: We are unable to open your account at this time

name: Account Creation Process
description: End-to-end system setup procedure for creating a new account in the Account Management System following branch or online opening. Includes account number assignment, product configuration, interest rate setting, and integration with linked systems. Automated processing completed within 15 minutes.
context: Account created in AMS (Account Management System)

name: Account Creation in AMS
description: Initial step where the new account is created and registered in the Account Management System as part of the account creation workflow.
context: Account created in AMS (Account Management System)

name: Account Number Assignment
description: Automated assignment of a unique account number in the format ACC-00XXX to the newly created account.

name: Product Settings Configuration
description: Configuration of product-specific settings and parameters for the newly created account based on the selected product type.

name: Interest Rate Setting
description: Application of the current interest rate schedule to the account as part of the product configuration process.

name: Linked Systems Update
description: Integration and synchronization of the newly created account with all linked downstream systems including online banking platform and fraud detection engine.
context: Linked systems updated (online banking, fraud engine, etc.)

name: Account Management System
description: Automated system responsible for creating accounts, assigning account numbers, configuring product settings, and recording account data during the account creation process.
context: Account created in AMS (Account Management System)
Linked systems updated (online banking, fraud engine, etc.)

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: Automated system linked to the account during creation to enable fraud monitoring and detection on the newly created account.
context: Linked systems updated (online banking, fraud engine, etc.)

name: Online Banking System
description: Automated system linked to the account during creation to enable online access and digital banking services for the account holder.
context: Linked systems updated (online banking, fraud engine, etc.)

name: New Account
description: A newly created account established through the account creation process in the Account Management System with an assigned account number and configured product settings.
context: Account created in AMS (Account Management System)

name: New Account
description: A newly created account that transitions to 'Active' status upon creation. The account can be opened with or without an initial deposit.

name: Cash Deposit Transaction
description: A cash deposit made at a branch as an initial funding method for a new account, with a maximum transaction limit of £10,000.
context: Cash Deposit: At branch (max £10k per transaction)

name: Transfer Deposit Transaction
description: A funds transfer from an existing bank account using Faster Payment Service (FPS) as an initial deposit method for account funding.

name: Check Deposit Transaction
description: A check deposit capability available via mobile app as a future feature for account funding.
context: Check Deposit: Via mobile app (future feature)

name: Card Issuance Process
description: End-to-end procedure for issuing and activating a debit card linked to a customer account. The process includes three delivery channels (branch, online, postal), card configuration (Visa Debit with contactless and chip), and PIN setup via multiple methods depending on channel.
context: Card issued immediately (if available in branch)
Card ordered via mail (5–7 business days)

name: Card Issuance via Branch
description: Immediate card issuance at branch location when card stock is available. Card is physically handed to customer at point of service.
context: Branch: Card issued immediately (if available in branch)

name: Card Issuance via Online Order
description: Card ordered through online channel and delivered by mail to customer address within 5–7 business days.
context: Online: Card ordered via mail (5–7 business days)

name: Card Issuance via Postal Order
description: Card ordered after account approval and delivered by post within 5–7 business days.
context: Postal: Card ordered after account approved (5–7 days)

name: PIN Setup at Branch
description: Customer sets Personal Identification Number at branch using PinPad device for immediate card activation.
context: Branch: PIN set by customer at branch (PinPad)

name: PIN Setup Online or via Phone
description: Customer sets PIN through online channel or telephone for card activation when not setting PIN at branch.
context: Online: PIN set online or via phone
Postal: PIN set via phone or online

name: Visa Debit Card
description: Visa-branded debit card linked to customer account with contactless and chip payment capabilities. Valid for 3 years from issuance.

name: Branch Staff
description: Branch personnel responsible for immediate card issuance when stock is available and for assisting customers with PIN setup via PinPad.
context: Branch: Card issued immediately (if available in branch)
Branch: PIN set by customer at branch (PinPad)

name: Customer
description: Account holder responsible for setting PIN and activating card through their chosen channel (branch, online, or phone).
context: PIN set by customer at branch (PinPad)
PIN set online or via phone

name: Card Activation Procedure
description: End-to-end procedure for activating a debit or credit card received by customer through mail or branch. Includes online, mobile, and phone activation channels with PIN confirmation. Activation completes same day at branch or next business day for online activation.
context: Same day (if at branch), next business day (if online)

name: Card Receipt
description: Customer receives the activated card through mail delivery.

name: Card Activation
description: Customer activates card through one of three channels: online banking, mobile app, or phone. This step enables the card for use in transactions.

name: PIN Confirmation
description: Customer confirms or sets their Personal Identification Number (PIN) as part of the card activation process.

name: Card Transaction Readiness
description: Card transitions to active status and becomes ready for use in financial transactions.

name: Customer
description: Individual who receives the card in mail and performs activation through their chosen channel (online, mobile, or phone).

name: Debit Card
description: Payment card issued to customer and activated through this procedure. Card is delivered by mail and requires activation before use in transactions.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end process for opening customer accounts across multiple channels (branch, online, postal). Culminates in Step 10 with customer notification via channel-specific confirmation methods including verbal, written, email, or postal delivery of account details.

name: Customer Notification
description: Final step in account opening where customers receive confirmation of their new account through their chosen channel. Includes delivery of account credentials, sort code, and online login details tailored to the customer's preferred contact method.

name: Branch Verbal Confirmation
description: In-person verbal confirmation provided to customers at the branch location upon account opening completion. Accompanied by written receipt and welcome pack.

name: Online Email Confirmation
description: Immediate email confirmation sent to online customers upon account creation, containing account details, number, sort code, and online login credentials.
context: Account number, sort code, online login details

name: Postal Letter Confirmation
description: Confirmation letter posted to customers the next day following account opening, including account number, sort code, and online login setup instructions.
context: Includes account number, sort code, online login setup instructions

name: Branch Staff
description: Branch-based staff responsible for providing verbal confirmation and delivering welcome packs to customers opening accounts in person at branch locations.

name: Email Notification System
description: Automated system responsible for sending immediate email confirmations to online customers upon account creation, including account details and login credentials.

name: Postal Delivery System
description: System responsible for generating and posting confirmation letters to customers the next day following account opening, containing account credentials and setup instructions.
context: Includes account number, sort code, online login setup instructions

name: New Account
description: Customer account newly created through the account opening process, for which confirmation and credentials are delivered through channel-specific notification methods.

name: Branch Customer
description: Customer who opens an account in person at a branch location and receives verbal confirmation, written receipt, and welcome pack.

name: Online Customer
description: Customer who opens an account online and receives immediate email confirmation with account details and login credentials.

name: Postal Customer
description: Customer who opens an account through postal application and receives confirmation letter posted the next day with account credentials and setup instructions.
context: Includes account number, sort code, online login setup instructions

name: Welcome Communications Process
description: End-to-end process for delivering welcome communications to new customers following account opening. Encompasses preparation and delivery of welcome letter, product guide, getting started guide, contact information, and fraud prevention advice through multiple channels with defined delivery timelines.
context: Getting started guide (online banking, mobile app)
Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Welcome Letter Preparation and Delivery
description: Preparation and delivery of welcome letter from CEO to new customer as part of welcome communications package. Delivered through branch (same day), email (next day), or postal (2-3 days).
context: Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Product Guide Delivery
description: Delivery of product guide containing terms, features, and frequently asked questions to new customer. Included in welcome communications package with multi-channel delivery options.
context: Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Getting Started Guide Delivery
aliases: Online Banking and Mobile App Guide
description: Delivery of getting started guide covering online banking and mobile app usage to new customer. Part of welcome communications with same-day, next-day, or 2-3 day delivery options.
context: Getting started guide (online banking, mobile app)
Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Contact Information Delivery
description: Provision of contact information to new customer as part of welcome communications package. Delivered through branch, email, or postal channels.
context: Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Fraud Prevention Advice Delivery
description: Delivery of fraud prevention advice to new customer as part of welcome communications. Included in welcome pack with multi-channel delivery timelines.
context: Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Branch Staff
description: Branch staff responsible for same-day delivery of welcome communications to customers at branch location.

name: Email Delivery System
description: Automated system responsible for next-day email delivery of welcome communications to customers.

name: Postal Delivery Service
description: Postal delivery service responsible for 2-3 day delivery of welcome communications to customers by mail.
context: Delivery: Same day (branch), next day (email), 2–3 days (postal)

name: Account Activation
description: End-to-end process for activating a newly opened account through online banking and mobile app setup. Encompasses credential delivery, first-time login, password management, security configuration, and biometric enrollment to enable full transactional access.

name: Online Banking Credential Delivery
description: Customer receives online banking credentials as the first step in account activation. This enables access to the online banking portal.

name: Online Banking Portal Access
description: Customer navigates to the FirstUK Bank login portal to initiate first-time access to online banking services.

name: Temporary Password Reset
description: Customer resets the temporary password provided at credential delivery to establish a permanent password for ongoing online banking access.

name: Security Questions Configuration
description: Customer sets up security questions as part of the online banking authentication and account recovery framework.

name: Online Banking Activation Completion
description: Final step confirming that online banking is fully active and ready for customer use following credential setup and security configuration.

name: Mobile App Download
description: Customer downloads the FirstUK Bank mobile application from the app store as the first step in mobile banking setup.

name: Mobile App Login
description: Customer logs into the mobile app using the same online banking credentials established during online banking setup.

name: Biometric Authentication Setup
description: Customer enrolls biometric authentication methods (fingerprint or face ID) on the mobile app to enable secure, convenient access to transactions.

name: Mobile App Transaction Activation
description: Final step confirming that the mobile app is fully active and ready for the customer to conduct transactions.

name: Customer
description: The account holder performing all steps in the account activation process, including receiving credentials, logging in, configuring security settings, and enrolling biometric authentication.

name: New Account
description: The newly opened account being activated through online banking and mobile app setup to enable full transactional access.

name: Access Activation Process
description: End-to-end procedure for fully activating a customer account across all systems and channels. The account becomes fully active only when KYC verification is complete, AML screening is passed, the account is created in all systems, card is issued and activated (if applicable), online/mobile access is configured, and the customer is notified.
context: Accounts Fully Active When: KYC verification complete, AML screening passed, Account created in all systems, Card issued and activated (if applicable), Online/mobile access configured, Customer notified

name: KYC Verification Completion
description: Verification step confirming that Know Your Customer identity and address verification has been completed as a prerequisite for account activation.

name: AML Screening Completion
description: Verification step confirming that Anti-Money Laundering screening has been passed as a prerequisite for account activation.

name: Account System Creation
description: Step to create and record the account across all banking systems as a prerequisite for full activation.

name: Card Issuance and Activation
description: Conditional step to issue and activate a payment card for the account when applicable.

name: Online and Mobile Access Configuration
description: Step to configure and enable online and mobile banking access for the customer account.

name: Customer Notification
description: Step to notify the customer that their account is fully active and ready for use.

name: Identity and Address Verification
description: Know Your Customer verification process that must be completed before account activation. This is a mandatory compliance checkpoint in the Access Activation Process.

name: Anti-Money Laundering Screening
description: AML screening process that must be passed before account activation. This is a mandatory compliance checkpoint in the Access Activation Process.

name: Debit Card
description: Payment card issued and activated as part of the Access Activation Process when applicable to the account.

name: New Account
description: Customer account being activated through the Access Activation Process. The account becomes fully active only after all activation prerequisites are met.

name: Individual Customer
description: Natural person who holds the account being activated and receives notification upon completion of the Access Activation Process.

name: KYC Verification Compliance Checkpoint
description: Mandatory regulatory compliance gate requiring completion of KYC verification before account activation can proceed.

name: AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint
description: Mandatory regulatory compliance gate requiring successful passage of AML screening before account activation can proceed.

name: Quality Assurance Process
description: A comprehensive quality assurance workflow executed before and after account approval to verify all required fields, compliance checks, data accuracy, and system setup. The process includes pre-approval verification of KYC, AML screening, risk assessment, and approval authority, followed by post-approval validation of account creation, balance recording, system updates, card issuance, and customer notification.
context: Before Approval: All required fields completed, KYC verification done (ID + Address), AML screening passed, Risk assessment documented, Approval obtained (per authority), Data entry accurate (spelling, numbers)
Post-Approval: Account created correctly in system, Initial balance (if any) recorded, Linked systems updated, Card ordered (if applicable), Customer notification sent, Account status active

name: Required Fields Completion Check
description: Pre-approval verification step ensuring all mandatory fields are completed before proceeding with account approval.

name: KYC Verification
description: Pre-approval compliance step verifying customer identity and address documentation as part of Know Your Customer requirements.

name: AML Screening Validation
description: Pre-approval compliance step confirming that Anti-Money Laundering screening has been completed and passed before account approval.

name: Risk Assessment Documentation
description: Pre-approval step requiring formal documentation of the customer risk assessment before approval authority is obtained.

name: Approval Authority Verification
description: Pre-approval step confirming that appropriate approval has been obtained according to delegated authority limits.

name: Data Entry Accuracy Check
description: Pre-approval verification step validating the accuracy of all data entry, including spelling and numerical values.

name: Account System Creation Verification
description: Post-approval step confirming that the account has been created correctly in the banking system.

name: Initial Balance Recording
description: Post-approval step recording any initial balance deposited to the newly created account.

name: Linked Systems Update
description: Post-approval step ensuring that all linked banking systems are updated with the new account information.

name: Card Issuance
description: Post-approval step ordering a payment card for the customer account when applicable.

name: Customer Notification
description: Post-approval step notifying the customer that their account has been successfully created and is active.

name: Account Status Activation
description: Post-approval step confirming that the account status has been set to active and is ready for use.

name: Approval Authority Role
description: The role responsible for granting approval according to delegated authority limits during the pre-approval quality assurance phase.

name: KYC Verification Compliance Checkpoint
description: Mandatory pre-approval compliance gate verifying that Know Your Customer requirements have been satisfied through collection and verification of identity and address documentation.

name: AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint
description: Mandatory pre-approval compliance gate confirming that Anti-Money Laundering screening has been completed and passed before account approval can proceed.

name: Identity and Address Verification
description: Know Your Customer verification process requiring collection and validation of customer identity documentation and address proof as a pre-approval requirement.

name: AML Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process that must be completed and passed as a mandatory pre-approval compliance requirement.

name: New Account
description: A newly created customer account subject to the quality assurance process, requiring system creation, initial balance recording, and activation.

name: Payment Card
description: A payment card ordered and issued to the customer account as part of the post-approval quality assurance process when applicable.

name: Monthly Audit Process
description: A recurring monthly audit procedure that reviews account opening files to verify KYC/AML completion, data accuracy, and timeliness of processing. The audit targets an error rate below 0.5% (99.5% accuracy threshold).
context: Monthly Audit: 10+ account opening files reviewed

name: Account Opening File Review
description: The initial step of the monthly audit in which 10 or more account opening files are selected and reviewed for compliance and accuracy.

name: KYC/AML Completion Verification
description: An audit step that verifies whether Know Your Customer and Anti-Money Laundering requirements have been completed for each reviewed account opening file.

name: Data Accuracy Verification
description: An audit step that validates the accuracy of data recorded in account opening files during the monthly review cycle.

name: Processing Timeliness Assessment
description: An audit step that assesses whether account opening files have been processed within required timeframes.

name: KYC/AML Completion Checkpoint
description: A mandatory compliance gate within the monthly audit that verifies completion of KYC and AML screening obligations before account opening files are deemed compliant.

name: KYC Verification
description: The Know Your Customer verification process that is subject to audit review in the monthly audit sampling procedure to ensure completion and compliance.

name: AML Screening
description: The Anti-Money Laundering screening process that is subject to audit review in the monthly audit sampling procedure to ensure completion and compliance.

name: New Account
description: Newly opened customer accounts that are subject to monthly audit sampling to verify KYC/AML completion, data accuracy, and processing timeliness.

name: Account Opening Process
description: End-to-end account opening workflow that includes KYC document verification, address verification, and AML screening. The process may encounter delays or exceptions requiring customer contact and escalation.

name: KYC Document Verification
description: Verification step where customer-provided identity documents are checked for validity and currency. Documents may be expired or invalid, requiring replacement.

name: Address Verification
description: Verification step comparing customer-provided address against identity document and verification records. Mismatches trigger customer contact and request for current address proof.
context: Explain requirement, request current address verification

name: AML Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening step that may experience system delays or generate hits requiring confirmation and potential escalation.
context: Wait for confirmation, escalate if needed

name: Form Completion Check
description: Validation step ensuring all required form fields are completed by the customer. Incomplete forms trigger customer contact to obtain missing information.

name: System Processing
description: Online system processing step for account opening that may experience delays requiring retry or support contact.

name: Customer Service Support
description: Support role responsible for contacting customers regarding incomplete forms, missing information, and persistent system issues.

name: Escalation Handler
description: Role responsible for escalating AML screening delays or hits that require confirmation and further investigation.

name: KYC Document Validity Check
description: Decision gate determining whether the provided KYC document is valid and current. Expired or invalid documents trigger a request for replacement.

name: Address Match Verification
description: Decision gate comparing identity document address against verification records. Mismatches require explanation to customer and current address verification.

name: AML Screening Result Gate
description: Decision gate evaluating AML screening outcome. System delays or hits found trigger confirmation wait and potential escalation.
context: Wait for confirmation, escalate if needed

name: Form Completeness Check
description: Decision gate verifying all required form fields are completed. Incomplete forms trigger customer contact for missing information.

name: System Processing Success Gate
description: Decision gate evaluating online system processing completion. Slow or failed processing triggers retry or support contact.

name: KYC Document Verification Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance gate ensuring valid KYC identification documents are collected and verified before account opening proceeds.

name: Address Verification Checkpoint
description: Mandatory compliance gate ensuring customer address is verified and matches identity documentation before account opening proceeds.

name: AML Screening Checkpoint
description: Mandatory regulatory compliance gate requiring AML screening completion and confirmation before account opening is finalized.

name: Identity Document
description: Official identity document collected during account opening that must be valid and current. Expired documents require replacement with new valid documentation.

name: Address Verification
description: Customer address verification process comparing identity document address against verification records. Mismatches require current address proof from customer.

name: Know Your Customer Verification
description: KYC compliance process involving document verification and address verification. Expired documents or address mismatches trigger customer contact and document replacement.

name: AML Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process that may experience system delays or generate hits requiring confirmation and escalation.
context: Wait for confirmation, escalate if needed

name: Account Opening Applicant
description: Individual applying to open an account who must provide valid KYC documentation, current address verification, and complete all required form fields.

name: Account Opening Procedure
description: The operational procedure for opening customer accounts, which is a mandatory annual training requirement for all staff. This procedure is foundational to the bank's customer onboarding workflow.

name: KYC Verification Procedure
description: The Know Your Customer identity and address verification process that must be completed during account opening. Annual training is mandatory for all staff to ensure consistent compliance with this procedure.

name: AML Procedure
description: The Anti-Money Laundering screening and monitoring procedure that staff must understand and execute. Annual training is mandatory to maintain staff competency in AML obligations and detection protocols.

name: Compliance Obligations Procedure
description: The overarching procedure covering regulatory and policy compliance obligations that staff must follow. Annual training is required to ensure all staff understand their compliance responsibilities.

name: Knowledge Assessment
description: A mandatory certification step where staff must pass a knowledge assessment to demonstrate competency in account opening, KYC, AML, and compliance procedures. This is a gate before staff can work independently.

name: Observed Practice
description: A certification step where a manager observes staff performing account opening and KYC procedures to verify practical competency before independent authorization.

name: Shadow Senior Staff
description: A mandatory certification step requiring new or retraining staff to shadow senior staff for a minimum of 10 accounts to gain practical experience in account opening and compliance procedures.

name: Branch Staff
description: Bank staff responsible for executing account opening, KYC verification, and AML procedures. All branch staff must complete annual training and certification in these procedures.

name: Manager
description: The manager responsible for observing staff practice and certifying competency in account opening and compliance procedures. Managers conduct the observed practice assessment as part of staff certification.

name: Senior Staff
description: Experienced staff members who mentor and train new or retraining staff by allowing them to shadow their work on a minimum of 10 accounts to develop practical competency.

name: Policy Customer Identification
description: Referenced policy document governing customer identification and Know Your Customer procedures. Provides the foundational regulatory and procedural framework for identity and address verification requirements.

name: Policy AML
description: Referenced policy document governing Anti-Money Laundering screening and compliance obligations. Establishes the framework for sanctions checks, PEP screening, and transaction monitoring requirements.

name: Business Ontology
description: Referenced document defining the Account entity and its structural properties. Provides the canonical data model and business rules for account representation across banking operations.

name: Savings Account
description: Savings account product referenced in product specifications. Governed by SAV-001-SPEC product specification document.

name: Current Account
description: Current account product referenced in product specifications. Governed by CURR-001-SPEC product specification document.

name: Mortgage
description: Mortgage product referenced in product specifications. Governed by MORT-001-SPEC product specification document.

name: KYC Verification SOP
description: Detailed standard operating procedure governing Know Your Customer verification processes. Provides step-by-step operational guidance for identity and address verification execution.

name: Head of Retail Banking
description: Senior leadership role responsible for authoring and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures for retail banking operations, including account opening, KYC requirements, branch staff training, and card activation procedures.
context: Added online opening procedures, card activation | Head of Retail Banking
Updated KYC requirements, branch staff training | Head of Retail Banking
Initial SOP | Head of Retail Banking

name: Head of Retail Banking
description: Senior executive responsible for retail banking operations who provides formal approval and sign-off on banking procedures and policies.
context: Approved by: Head of Retail Banking — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Head of Compliance
description: Senior compliance executive responsible for regulatory oversight and formal approval of banking procedures to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
context: Approved by: Head of Compliance — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Chief Operating Officer
description: Executive-level officer responsible for operational oversight and final approval authority for banking procedures and policies.
context: Approved by: Chief Operating Officer — Date: 2026-01-15
